recipe.title: Calorie-Conscious Creamy Chicken Pasta
instructions: Cook the whole wheat pasta according to package instructions until al dente, then drain.
In a skillet, cook the chicken breast over medium heat until fully cooked and no longer pink, about 7-10 minutes. Slice or cube the chicken.
In a bowl, mix the low-fat Greek yogurt with the grated Parmesan until well combined.
Add the yogurt mixture to the cooked chicken in the skillet and warm it on low heat, stirring gently to create a creamy sauce without boiling.
Combine the cooked pasta with the creamy chicken sauce and serve.
changes: Substituted regular pasta with whole wheat pasta for added fiber and lower calorie density.
Replaced heavy cream with low-fat Greek yogurt to reduce fat and calories while maintaining creaminess.
Reduced the amount of Parmesan cheese to lower overall calories while still providing flavor.
warnings: The texture of the sauce will be different compared to using heavy cream.
Ensure the Greek yogurt is warmed gently to avoid curdling.
Adjust seasoning as lower-fat ingredients may change the flavor profile; additional spices may be needed.
